Jeremy Rys researches the UFO phenomenon's documentary record. He joins Danny Jones to present what he calls explosive new evidence in the Bob Lazar case. He also brings Area 51 secrets he says can now be revealed. Lazar's 1989 claims about working on alien craft near Area 51 made him the whistleblower archetype, and they remain unverified and fiercely argued.

Rys works the paper trail: employment records, timing, and the statements of others placed near Lazar's story. Jones follows the documents rather than the legend. Believers will hear corroboration; skeptics will hear the same gaps as always. The episode's value is its method, a researcher laying out exhibits in order. It preserves the Lazar debate in its current state, evidence-focused and unresolved, for an audience still split by a story told the year the Berlin Wall fell.
